Quotes / Wang Fuzhi / Q0464

English

The great method of ordering the world lies in discerning the times and gauging the situation.
Thinker Wang Fuzhi
School Ming–Qing Practical Learning
Source Du Tongjian Lun
Theme Philosophy
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Du Tongjian Lun, within the tradition of Ming–Qing Practical Learning. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of philosophy, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Wang Fuzhi's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
